description: In the early 1990s, Soren Rasmussen was engaged by David McLean — the CN Rail chairman and philanthropist who spearheaded the project — to design the interior of McLean Hall at St. George's School in Vancouver.

For three decades the hall served as the school community's gathering and dining hall, the room where the school met, celebrated and shared meals. St. George's own "Builders of St. George's School" tribute credits the commission with "raising the bar for philanthropy and redefining what our School can achieve."
note: Photography for this project has not yet been recovered from the archives.
